segments.text: What has both size and direction?
segments.visual_plan: Dark screen. A glowing BLUE arrow appears at center, pointing upwards. Camera slowly rotates around it.
segments.title: Hook

segments.text: Vectors are used in physics, engineering, and more.
segments.visual_plan: Arrow remains. Multiple YELLOW arrows of varying lengths and directions appear around it. Camera pulls back to show diverse vectors in 3D space.
segments.title: Context

segments.text: A vector has magnitude and direction.
segments.visual_plan: A RED line with an arrowhead morphs into a GREEN vector with a clear magnitude (length) and direction. Camera zooms in on the vector's tip.
segments.title: Foundation

segments.text: Vectors can be added and scaled.
segments.visual_plan: Two BLUE vectors of different lengths and directions appear. They combine into a single PURPLE vector. Camera rotates to show the resulting vector in 3D space.
segments.title: Core Concept

segments.text: Vector addition is commutative and associative.
segments.visual_plan: Multiple TEAL vectors appear, demonstrating the properties of vector addition. Camera pans to show different combinations of vectors, with resulting vectors changing color to YELLOW when added correctly.
segments.title: Deep Dive

segments.text: Forces acting on an object can be represented as vectors.
segments.visual_plan: A Cube appears, with multiple vectors (representing forces) acting on it. Vectors are colored GREEN (upwards force), RED (downwards force), and BLUE (sideways force). Camera zooms out to show the net force as a single vector, colored PURPLE.
segments.title: Example

segments.text: Vectors: size, direction, and powerful operations.
segments.visual_plan: All previous vectors fade out, leaving a single, glowing BLUE vector at the center. Camera slowly orbits around it, as the screen fades to black.
segments.title: Summary
